description: OpsRAG access policy. For each role: which kinds of data it may read and, per kind, which sensitivity labels. Labels are compartments, not a ladder. 'confidential' can never be granted. Tool permissions follow from the grants (documents -> documents:read, ...); 'capabilities' adds interfaces that read several kinds of data (query_database), which still only sees rows the grants allow.

developer.description: Product engineers: engineering documentation, source code and non-sensitive incidents.

sre.description: Site reliability engineers: engineering documentation, all incidents, logs, runbooks and deployments.

manager.description: Engineering and support managers: operational reports, all incidents and non-sensitive documents.

admin.description: Platform and security administrators: all project data the assistant may use (never confidential).
